preferredVisionOSRuntime: Core ML with MLModelConfiguration.computeUnits = .cpuAndNeuralEngine (ANE-preferred). Use DA3_COMPUTE_UNITS=strict_ane in the demo to fail load instead of falling back to .all.

currentCompiledArtifact.note: The checked-in compiled model is fixed at 336x336. Do not request 384x216 at runtime unless a new flexible or fixed 384x216 model is compiled and bundled.

input.name: image
input.shape: 1x1x3xHxW for the DA3 Small wrapper used by this demo
input.note: 384x216 is a future export target for lower latency. Include model-specific mean/std preprocessing in the exported graph or Core ML preprocessing.

output.shape: 1x1xHxW, 1xHxW, HxW, or image; KSPlayer reads the last two non-unit axes as height and width
output.normalization: Finite values are min/max normalized per frame unless VideoDepthProcessingConfiguration.normalization is .none. Larger normalized values are treated as closer to the viewer.

conversion.note: Export DA3-Small depth branch only (no ray-map head). Convert with FP16 and compute_units cpuAndNeuralEngine. Profile in Xcode Core ML Instruments — CPU transformer layers indicate ANE fallback (~5 fps). Temporary fallback: Depth Anything V2 Small Core ML via KSPlayer DepthAnythingV2DepthEstimationAdapter.

onnxRuntimeFallback.note: Prefer Core ML for Vision Pro real-time playback. ONNX Runtime requires an app-supplied visionOS-compatible C library/framework.
